# atlassian_organization_user_organization_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an organization-level role directly to an Atlassian organization user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_organization_user" "office_it" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  emails          = ["office-it@example.com"]
}

resource "atlassian_organization_user_organization_role_assignment" "office_it" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  account_id      = one(data.atlassian_organization_user.office_it.users).account_id
  role            = "atlassian/org-admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Opaque Atlassian account ID.
- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID used to read the user's current role assignments.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.
- `role` (String) Atlassian organization-level role. Currently only atlassian/org-admin is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite organization-level role assignment identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_organization_user_organization_role_assignment.office_it

  identity = {
    organization_id = "your-organization-id"
    directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
    account_id      = "your-account-id"
    role            = "atlassian/org-admin"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `account_id` (String) Opaque Atlassian account ID.
- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID used to read the user's current role assignments.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.
- `role` (String) Atlassian organization-level role.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_organization_user_organization_role_assignment.office_it
  id = "organization-id,directory-id,account-id,atlassian/org-admin"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import atlassian_organization_user_organization_role_assignment.office_it 'organization-id,directory-id,account-id,atlassian/org-admin'
```
